title: A Birthday Invitation
text:
Hello, Ali! My birthday is next Saturday. I want to have a party at my house. Please come at 3 o'clock. There will be cake, music, and games.

Please tell me if you can come. You can call me or send a message. Bring a gift if you want. I hope to see you there!

questions.text: How can the guest tell the writer if they can come?
options: By calling or sending a message
By sending a letter by post
By sending an email to the school

questions.text: Why does the writer invite Ali?
options: The writer wants to share the birthday party with a friend
The writer wants to sell a cake
The writer wants to go to school with Ali
The writer wants to buy a new house

questions.text: What kind of text is this?

vocabulary.definition: an event where people eat, play and have fun together
something you give to someone, often on a special day
a short written or spoken note sent to someone

paragraph_translations: Merhaba Ali! Doğum günüm gelecek cumartesi. Evimde bir parti yapmak istiyorum. Lütfen saat 3'te gel. Pasta, müzik ve oyunlar olacak.
Lütfen gelip gelemeyeceğini bana söyle. Beni arayabilir ya da mesaj gönderebilirsin. İstersen bir hediye getir. Seni orada görmeyi umuyorum!
